summary: Coverage-ledger-gated work now depends on a richer exported artifact package rather than a single manifest file. The repo can build that export from runtime state, and the workflow checker rejects missing or malformed manifest/items/gaps/dependency/traces artifacts.

release_readiness.reason: This slice changes shipped workflow-check semantics. Focused unit, integration, and installed-fixture checks passed, and the richer gate now fails closed instead of over-accepting manifest-only evidence.

residual_risk: This slice hardens exported ledger packaging but does not yet generate the deeper code-understanding inventories promised by the redesign.
Runtime trace capture remains a later slice; the current traces artifact is exported from existing runtime state only.
